newsitem.title: UK: Dawson Intl says to buy Forte Cashmere unit.
newsitem.headline: Dawson Intl says to buy Forte Cashmere unit.

text.p: British knitwear manufacturer Dawson International said on Wednesday that it had signed a deal to buy the garment division of U.S.-based Forte Cashmere Company Inc.
Dawson's chairman Derek Finlay said in a statement the aquisition will enable the company to penetrate into the private label cashmere market in the U.S.
Forte Cashmere is one of the largest distributors of Chinese produced cashmere knitwear in the U.S. with sales of over $8.5 million last year.

Dawson said the deal will be completed on January 1, 1997 through an initial goodwill cash payment of $1.0 million. The balance consideration will be linked to Forte's profit levels over the next five years, the statement added.
Dawson said it will continue to operate the unit from Forte's existing headquarters in South Natick, near Boston, Massachusetts.
Richard Forte, the grandson of the U.S. company's founder will remain president of the division.
